source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: No local-government RV campground is missing in Connecticut. Good Sam's one public row (White Memorial, Point Folly) is a private foundation's; OSM's town-tagged sites are a residents-only reserve and a recreation center. About 40 private campgrounds are unmatched - outside this pass.
